labeller: Claude (Sonnet 5.5), one labeller, no second annotator
design:
Real claim-level TP/FP/FN for answer_correctness (2026-10-09). Reads the pack READ-ONLY (answers, claims, correctness, questions) and writes answer_correctness.real.json.
LABELS = hand labels made by Claude (Sonnet 5.5, one labeller, no second annotator) on 2026-10-09 by reading each gold answer and each claim of the pack's
claims.json (the claims the faithfulness judge extracted from each answer):
  1. GOLD claims = the gold answer split by hand into short atomic claims (GOLD below).
  2. For every ANSWER claim: 'T' + gold claim numbers it states (a paraphrase counts; arguable ones carry a trailing '?'), or 'F' when it states nothing in the gold answer
     (a true but extra detail, a restated premise of the question, an abstention, or a wrong fact all count as FP: that is how Ragas defines the factual part).
  3. TP = answer claims labelled T; FP = answer claims labelled F; FN = gold claims that no answer claim states.
Cosine = cosine of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence vectors of the answer text and the gold answer text: a local STAND-IN for the OpenAI embedding model Ragas uses.
Only the 9 answerable questions are labelled (the 3 unanswerable ones have no gold answer).
